title: Pooling - 2ml Tuberack to 15ml Tuberack
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Select pooling configuration
steps.instruction: Choose the pooling mode “2 ml Tuberack to 15 ml Tuberack” for this protocol.

steps.title: Specify worklist
steps.instruction:
Enter the worklist in the OT App exactly as shown, including all numbers, commas and spaces:
```
Number 8 pos TB_RCK_1,pos MTP_1,transfer_vol TUBE BAR 1,TUBE BAR 1 1,1,200 2,35,200 3,2,150 4,90,100 5,84 6,62 7,42 8,18 ...
```

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App go to **More** → **Custom Labware** → **Add Labware** and select your custom labware files (file extension *.json*) if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App **Protocol** tab, upload the protocol file (file extension *.py*).

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App calibration workflow (see support articles for tips).

steps.title: Run protocol
steps.instruction: Press the **Run** button in the OT App to start the protocol.
